description: This PHP source file defines the Store class within the Opencart Admin Model Setting namespace. It provides methods to manage store records in an OpenCart-based eCommerce platform, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving store information, as well as creating store instances and managing related dependencies.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Class for managing store data in the OpenCart admin panel, including CRUD operations and store instance creation.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Creates a new store record in the database with provided data, sets up layout and SEO URL routes, and clears cache.

methods.name: editStore
methods.description: Updates an existing store record identified by store_id with new data, and clears cache.

methods.name: deleteStore
methods.description: Deletes a store record and all associated data across various related models, then clears cache.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Fetches the store record for a given store_id; returns default info for store_id 0.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves a list of stores with optional pagination filters.

methods.name: getTotalStores
methods.description: Returns the total count of store records.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the total number of stores using a specific layout ID.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByLanguage
methods.description: Returns the total number of stores configured with a specific language.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByCurrency
methods.description: Returns the total number of stores configured with a specific currency.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByCountryId
methods.description: Returns the total number of stores with a specific country ID.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByZoneId
methods.description: Returns the total number of stores with a specific zone ID.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByCustomerGroupId
methods.description: Returns the total number of stores associated with a specific customer group ID.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByInformationId
methods.description: Returns the total number of stores linked to specific information IDs for account and checkout.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByOrderStatusId
methods.description: Returns the total number of stores with a specific order status ID.

methods.name: createStoreInstance
methods.description: Initializes and returns a store-specific registry with loaded configurations, events, and dependencies based on store_id and language.
